title: Eylsia Nicolas reclaims joy, reinvention, and strength in "People Say"
htmlContent: Eylsia Nicolas' "People Say" arrives on a wind of change and unbounded joy. Inspired in part by a reunion with an old friend working on the Dusty Springfield hologram project, Nicolas breathed boldly contemporary life into that 1960s soul feel. The outcome is a punchy, pop-heavy track that combines old-school rhythm with modern sophistication, serving as proof that classic influence can be reinvented from a fresh perspective. "People Say" is an anthem for resilience and transformation. Rooted in soul but flavored with house-infused percussion, the track derives its power from contrast. Nicolas builds an auditory world that is both intimate and cosmic, celebrating movement, freedom, and the simple joy of being alive. https://open.spotify.com/track/6bLlWANl4BEYSJkT3f3zwz The appeal of "People Say" lies in its seamless ability to hop across eras. The song itself is a testament to her artistic curiosity and the willingness to revisit its source material until it becomes something wholly her own. The song's energy parallels the message that whatever anyone has to say, happiness comes with accepting your authentic self. "People Say" projects an infectious vibe of upbeat positivity. It builds bridges and creates a positive atmosphere, and it feels alive. Eylsia Nicolas provides not only a sound in her warm beats and soulful turns, but rather the feeling of self-discovery, confidence, and the pure joy of making something truly memorable.
